summary: The preload gate can pass when audio decoding fails. The README byte counts match disk, but the observed JSON timing differs from the plan record.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] review-c: scripts/audio-budget.mjs:149-150,194-224 checks resource timing and browser errors but does not verify decoded playback. src/apk3d/audio/bus.ts:212-221,315-329 catches decode failures and uses the synth fallback, so all six downloads can pass the gate without a decoded sound. Verify decode success separately from the network timing metric required by test-strategy.md:355-360.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Major] review-c: plan.md:636-639 matches the two Green log runs, but the observed out/audio-budget/rune-match.json reports 0.7038000000715255 s, not the recorded repeat of 0.7216000000238418 s. Preserve the matching repeat output with its run evidence. The byte and file counts agree.

F3 [Nit] review-c: scripts/audio-budget.mjs:50-53 rejects a missing or unknown game with exit 1 before launch, but prints a stack trace for usage errors, including --help. Print a concise usage line and identify the invalid argument.
